ja: 田中さんにデータの確認を頼みました。
en: I asked Tanaka to check the data.
alternatives: I asked Tanaka to review the data.
I asked Tanaka to double-check the data.
point: 「人に〜を頼む」は ask 人 to 動詞 の形

ja: 最終判断をうちに任せてくれるなら、引き受けます。
en: We'll take it if the final call is ours.
alternatives: We'll do it if we get the final say.
We'll take it if the final decision is ours.
point: 条件は if 節、未来のことでも中身は現在形

ja: 彼は引き受ける前に、締め切りを確認すべきでした。
en: He should've checked the deadline before taking it on.
alternatives: He should have checked the deadline before accepting.
He should have looked at the deadline before agreeing.
point: しなかった後悔は should have + 過去分詞

ja: あの時、彼女はもう別件を受けてた。
en: She'd already taken on another job by then.
alternatives: By then she'd already accepted another project.
She'd already agreed to another job by then.
point: その時点より前の完了は had + 過去分詞

ja: 君に手伝いを頼もうと、ずっと思ってた。
en: I've been meaning to ask you for help.
alternatives: I've been meaning to ask for your help.
I've been wanting to ask you for help.
point: 前から思っていた → have been meaning to + 動詞

ja: うちは予算を確認して、その仕事を受けた。
en: Having checked the budget, we accepted the job.
alternatives: After checking the budget, we took the job.
We checked the budget, then took the job.
point: 先に済ませた動作は Having checked で表す

ja: 期限を延ばしても、この翻訳、受けてもらえますか？
en: Even with extra time, could you handle this translation?
alternatives: Even with an extension, could you take on this translation?
Even with more time, could you take on this translation?
point: 「延ばしても」は Even with で譲歩を示す

ja: 午後なら手伝えますよ。
en: I can help this afternoon.
alternatives: I'm free to help this afternoon.
This afternoon, I can help you.
point: 「手伝える」は can help。時間は文末に置く

ja: 今忙しいから、あとで手伝うね。
en: I'm busy now, so I'll help later.
alternatives: I'm busy right now. I'll help later.
I'm swamped now. I'll help later.
point: その場で決めた申し出は I'll + 動詞

ja: 彼があの時断っていたら、今は忙しくないのに。
en: If he'd declined, he wouldn't be busy now.
alternatives: If he'd said no, he wouldn't be busy now.
He wouldn't be busy now if he'd turned it down.
point: if 節は過去完了、主節は今の話なので wouldn't be

ja: 経理に強い田中さんに頼んだほうがいいよ。
en: You should ask Tanaka, who knows accounting.
alternatives: I'd ask Tanaka, who knows accounting well.
You should ask Tanaka, who's good with accounting.
point: 人の補足説明はカンマ＋who でつなぐ

ja: 早く頼んでくれたら、終わらせられたのに。
en: If you'd asked sooner, I could've finished it.
alternatives: I could've finished it if you'd asked sooner.
If you'd told me earlier, I could've done it.
point: 過去の仮定は had asked と could have finished

ja: 部長が二の足を踏んだのは、量じゃなく締め切りのせいだ。
en: It was the deadline, not the workload, that made our manager balk.
alternatives: What made our manager balk was the deadline, not the workload.
It wasn't the workload but the deadline that made our manager hesitate.
point: 強調したい語を It was と that ではさむ

ja: 水曜まで時間があれば、引き受けられるんですが。
en: If I had until Wednesday, I could do it.
alternatives: I could handle it if I had until Wednesday.
If I had till Wednesday, I could take it.
point: 仮の条件は if 節を過去形、主節を could にする

ja: ごめん、今週は忙しくて手伝えないんだ。
en: Sorry, I can't help. I'm swamped this week.
alternatives: Sorry, I'm too busy to help this week.
I'm tied up this week and can't help.
point: 「手伝えない」は can't help で言い切る

ja: 予算が通れば引き受けると、私は言いました。
en: I said I'd take it if the budget passed.
alternatives: I said I'd accept if the budget passed.
I said I'd do it if the budget passed.
point: said の後は will を would に、時制をそろえる

ja: 彼女、原稿が早く届くなら訳すって言ってたよ。
en: She said she'd translate if the draft arrives early.
alternatives: She said she'd translate if it comes early.
She said she'd translate if the draft came early.
point: 言ったのは過去なので will が would (she'd) になる

ja: うちは忙しすぎて、受けられません。
en: We're too busy to take that on.
alternatives: We're too busy to take it on.
We're too busy to take it.
point: 「忙しすぎて〜できない」は too busy to 動詞

ja: データ入力は来週、外注に出されます。
en: Data entry will be outsourced next week.
alternatives: Next week, data entry will be outsourced.
Data entry gets outsourced next week.
point: 作業が外注される側なので will be + 過去分詞

ja: 金曜までに契約書を見ていただけないでしょうか。
en: Would you mind looking over the contract by Friday?
alternatives: Could you look over the contract by Friday?
Would you mind reviewing the contract by Friday?
point: 丁寧な依頼は Would you mind + ing

ja: 彼女は引き受けただけでなく、手伝うとまで言ってくれた。
en: Not only did she agree, she offered to pitch in.
alternatives: She not only agreed, she offered to pitch in as well.
Not only did she accept, she also offered to help.
point: Not only を文頭に置くと did she の語順になる

ja: 早く頼めばよかった。締め切りは明日だ。
en: I wish I'd asked sooner. The deadline's tomorrow.
alternatives: I should've asked sooner. The deadline's tomorrow.
If only I'd asked sooner. The deadline's tomorrow.
point: 過去の後悔は I wish のあとを過去完了に

ja: 見積もり、まだ届いてません。今日もらえますか？
en: The quote still hasn't arrived. Could you send it today?
alternatives: I haven't gotten the quote. Can you send it today?
The quote hasn't come yet. Can you send it today?
point: まだ届いていない、は現在完了 hasn't arrived

ja: これを部長に渡してください。
en: Please give this to the manager.
alternatives: Please hand this to the manager.
Please pass this to the manager.
point: 命令文は動詞の原形で始め、Please を添える

ja: 資料をまとめていただけないかと思いまして。
en: I was wondering if you'd put together the materials.
alternatives: Could you possibly put together the materials?
I was hoping you could put together the materials.
I was wondering if you could put the materials together.
point: was wondering if you'd で丁寧に依頼を切り出す

ja: うちに必要なのは、確認してくれる人です。
en: What we need is someone to check it.
alternatives: What we need is somebody to check it.
We need someone to check it.
point: 「必要なのは〜」は What we need is で始める

ja: 彼の依頼、受けなきゃよかった。手いっぱいだ。
en: I wish I hadn't taken it. I'm swamped.
alternatives: I shouldn't have taken his request. I'm swamped.
I wish I'd said no. I'm swamped.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + had 過去分詞で表す

ja: データ整理は助手にやってもらってもいいですか？
en: Can I have my assistant sort out the data?
alternatives: Could I have my assistant organize the data?
Can I get my assistant to sort the data?
point: 人にやってもらうは have 人＋動詞の原形
